parent_objective: design a current-simulator controlled comparison benchmark branch after generated-proxy scaffolding reaches its claim boundary
blocked_by: M2146 pivots away from generated-proxy support scaffolding
paper route requires fair L0/L1/L2/L3 current-simulator comparison before ranking or self-ID verdicts
supersedes: further generated-proxy denominator/support-matrix local process milestones
direct finite-window-vs-GRU or recurrent-memory claims from M2144 diagnostics

public_gates: M2147 must design a current-simulator controlled comparison benchmark branch
M2147 must define controller-family matrix L0/L1/L2/L3 and reset/truncated controls
M2147 must define task families and metrics before any measured execution
M2147 must preserve the deployable actor input and actuator-level output contract
M2147 must not run reset rollout measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts a new branch to design a paper-route current-simulator controlled comparison benchmark after generated-proxy scaffolding is closed
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: benchmark design only; no rollout driver performance ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design ranks controller families before execution
stop if design treats generated-proxy rows as paper-valid evidence
stop if design omits L0/L1/L2/L3 fairness controls
stop if design omits reset/truncated controls for recurrent-memory interpretation
stop if design changes actor inputs or action contract
fallback_plan: design a no-rollout benchmark-spec schema preflight if direct execution is not ready
design a task-family materialization preflight if task semantics need repair
stop and run a complexity-pruning audit if the required benchmark becomes too broad for current simulator evidence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2146 pivot opens a new current-simulator controlled comparison benchmark branch

admission_evidence: self-id paper route requires L0/L1/L2/L3 fair matrix
finite-window-vs-GRU plan requires current-response and reset controls
M2144 generated-proxy diagnostics are insufficient for ranking or self-ID
blocked_shortcuts: do not run the benchmark in M2147
do not rank controller families from generated-proxy artifacts
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage without reset/truncated and finite-window controls
allowed_updates: M2147 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for benchmark-spec preflight implementation
next_stage_criteria: task families and metrics are specified
claim ladder and stop conditions are specified
next preflight or fallback route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2147 designs the fair comparison route and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: M2147 must design wrong/delayed/reset/truncated history tests as future gates, but does not execute them.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2146 synthesis and governing paper-route plans.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If finite-window or reset controls match online GRU in later execution, record that as valid engineering evidence and weaken self-ID claims instead of repairing toward GRU.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: opens a new paper-route branch outside the generated-proxy comparison-support local loop
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can define the route to paper-valid current-sim evidence but cannot make a verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2147 proposes another generated-proxy support-matrix refinement
M2147 cannot define fair L0/L1/L2/L3 controls
M2147 routes directly to ranking or self-ID verdict

hypothesis: A current-simulator controlled comparison benchmark can be designed around the paper-route L0/L1/L2/L3 matrix and decisive task families, avoiding another generated-proxy local loop.
success_criteria: task families and metrics are explicit
next preflight or fallback route is explicit
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: task families or metrics are missing
ranking or paper-level claims are made
decision_rule: M2147 passes if it freezes a benchmark design route with fair controller-family controls and explicit next preflight without execution or ranking.
